citation: Shekhawat VS, Bhansali S, Dutta P, et al. Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Polypeptide (GIP) Resistance and β-cell Dysfunction Contribute to Hyperglycaemia in Acromegaly. Scientific Reports. 2019.
protocol: Mixed meal test: 10 kcal/kg Ensure powder (57% carbohydrate, 13.5% fat, 15.1% protein) after 12 h overnight fast; also hyperinsulinaemic euglycaemic clamp in patients (before and after surgery)
population: Healthy controls n=10 (age, BMI, HbA1c matched) vs 20 patients with acromegaly (10 with, 10 without diabetes; age 34.6+/-9.0 y)
note: Only the healthy-control column is usable as normal physiology; acromegaly groups are a disease cohort pulse cannot represent. Summary values only (AUC, fasting).
